name: codepilot-ai
description: CodePilot AI — autonomous software engineering workspace.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n packages,api,web,agent -c cyan,blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:packages" "npm run dev -w @codepilot/api" "npm run dev -w @codepilot/web" "npm run dev -w @codepilot/agent"
scripts.dev:packages: concurrently -n types,config,logger,security,ai,index,github,tools,database "tsc -w -p packages/types/tsconfig.build.json --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -w -p packages/config/tsconfig.build.json --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -w -p packages/logger/tsconfig.build.json --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -w -p packages/security/tsconfig.build.json --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -w -p packages/ai/tsconfig.build.json --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -w -p packages/indexing/tsconfig.build.json --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -w -p packages/github/tsconfig.build.json --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -w -p packages/tools/tsconfig.build.json --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -w -p packages/database/tsconfig.build.json --preserveWatchOutput"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @codepilot/types && npm run build -w @codepilot/config && npm run build -w @codepilot/logger && npm run build -w @codepilot/security && npm run build -w @codepilot/ai && npm run build -w @codepilot/indexing && npm run build -w @codepilot/github && npm run build -w @codepilot/tools && npm run build -w @codepilot/database
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @codepilot/api && npm run build -w @codepilot/agent && npm run build -w @codepilot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
